Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Wood and Iron Hanging Wall Mirror, 32.25 Inch Height, Brown and Black
Colors: Glass
Materials: glass
This modern mirror artfully combines wood and iron for hints of classic and industrial style. The natural color of the wide rubber wood plank paired with narrow black iron trim makes it a striking addition to a bedroom, hallway or mantel. Classic, modern and industrial touches help it blend anywhere Glass, solid rubber wood and iron with black finish 21"W x 1.75"D x 32.25"H Avoid moisture. Wipes clean with soft, dry cloth. Hanging hardware not included.
